Home.title_desription: Full-Stack web developer, Software engineer, and Game developer.
Home.description: My name is Thai Duy Vu, a Computer Science Engineer graduated from Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT). I bring over 3 years of experience in building scalable web applications using Java, Spring Boot, React, Angular, and Vue. Characterized by a positive attitude and high energy, I have a proven ability to quickly learn and effectively apply new technologies, programming languages, frameworks, and libraries to real-world projects. I am recognized as a collaborative team player who actively supports colleagues, contributing to a positive and productive work environment. I am deeply committed to continuous self-improvement through challenging projects. I am confident that my proactiveness, growth mindset, and adaptability to technological advancements will allow me to deliver significant value to your team and organization.

systemEXE.title: SystemEXE Vietnam
systemEXE.description: Full-stack Developer at SystemEXE Vietnam. Responsible for developing and upgrading projects based on requirements from Japanese clients.

carshare.title: CarShare
carshare.description: A car rental management project. Served as a Team Lead for a group of 5 members. Primary responsibilities included upgrading the system from Spring Boot 3.5 to Spring Boot 4, transitioning from Jackson 2 to Jackson 3, and updating all related libraries to their latest versions.

heatmap.title: Heatmap
heatmap.description: An IoT project for monitoring and displaying office temperature, humidity, and pressure. Key responsibilities involved gathering requirements and developing the entire system from scratch, including the frontend, backend, and IoT device integration.

Komatsu.title: Administration System
Komatsu.description: A web-based management system providing administrative functions and customer interfaces. Main tasks included developing new features per client requests, as well as investigating and optimizing SQL query performance.

Mars.title: Accounting Management System
Mars.description: An accounting system that supports businesses in recording transactions, managing vouchers/ledgers, and generating financial reports. Primary duties included upgrading the .NET Framework version, migrating from Seasar to Dapper, and testing/fixing batch processing (.bat) tasks.

GCS.title: Real Estate Contract Management System
GCS.description: A comprehensive digital solution designed to optimize real estate management and transactions through advanced technology. Built to support multiple stakeholders—including agents, buyers, sellers, and administrators—the platform enables seamless management of property portfolios, client interactions, and contract workflows. Key responsibilities involved upgrading from Vue 2 to Vue 3, migrating Java 8 to Java 21, and developing new features based on technical designs.

Fluzo.title: Music Copyright Management System
Fluzo.description: A system aimed at streamlining copyright licensing and improving accuracy within the digital content distribution sector. Main tasks included upgrading from Java 8 to Java 17 and utilizing Electron to embed existing web features into a desktop application.

CIIC.title: Application Form Management System
CIIC.description: A system supporting the management of various application forms and documents. Primary responsibilities included receiving requirements and designs from Japanese clients and implementing features based on those specifications.

RMS.title: Resource Management System
RMS.description: A comprehensive system designed to optimize the allocation and utilization of company resources, including personnel, equipment, time, and financial assets. The project followed the Agile methodology. My main role involved analyzing client requirements, followed by designing and developing new features for the system.

topebox.title: TOPEBOX
topebox.subTitle: Intern Game Developer
topebox.description: Game development intern at TOPEBOX. Guided in game programming using the new Unity's Data-Oriented Technology Stack (DOTS).

fujinet.subTitle: Full Stack Developer
fujinet.description: Full stack developer at Fujinet Systems JSC. Responsible for developing and fixing the MDware system (MDware fully covers all functions of the item master system, ordering system (automatic), sales management system, and so on). The project is developed using Java and the Struts framework.
